title_zh: 明确活动副负责人的决定范围

scenario.label_zh: 明确活动副负责人可作出的决定
scenario.goal_zh: 指定副负责人，并确认其可调整志愿者安排但不能增加支出

context_zh: 一场社区讲座的负责人出差前与同事交接组织工作。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: I need to designate someone to lead the lecture team while I am away. Would you do it?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Yes, but I need to know what decisions I can make.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: You will be my deputy. I want to empower you to move volunteers between tasks without waiting for me.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Can I also order extra equipment if a speaker asks for it?

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Not without approval. The budget is fixed, so please send any spending request to the finance lead.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: That is clear: I can change the rota, but I cannot increase spending.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Exactly. I will tell the team that you are their first contact for staffing changes.
